title: eBay EU brand seller discovery
description: Find sellers from public eBay brand searches or brand pages, restrict item evidence to Europe, then verify public seller profiles.

campaignId.title: Aime campaign ID
campaignId.description: Optional Campaign identifier passed through to Dataset, OUTPUT and PROGRESS.

shardId.title: Aime shard ID
shardId.description: Optional shard identifier passed through to Dataset, OUTPUT and PROGRESS.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Optional brand names converted directly into eBay UK search sources. Leave empty together with startUrls to use the balanced default portfolio: Gucci, CHANEL, Nike and Apple.

startUrls.title: Brand page URLs
startUrls.description: Optional eBay /b/<brand>/bn_<id> URLs. In API requests, pass request objects such as [{"url":"https://www.ebay.com/b/Gucci/bn_21826083?LH_PrefLoc=5&mag=1"}].

sellerCountries.title: Seller countries
sellerCountries.description: United Kingdom (GB) by default. Enter EU or ISO alpha-2 country codes; UK is normalized to GB. Seller country is verified from the public About page.

maxListingsPerBrand.title: Listings per brand
maxListingsPerBrand.description: Maximum Europe-filtered product links sampled from each selected brand page.

maxItemDetails.title: Maximum item details
maxItemDetails.description: Maximum Europe-filtered item pages opened to identify sellers.

maxSellerProfiles.title: Maximum seller profiles
maxSellerProfiles.description: Maximum unique seller profiles enriched after item discovery.

maxSellers.title: Maximum sellers to output
maxSellers.description: Maximum qualified EU seller leads written to the Dataset.

minFeedbackScore.title: Minimum feedback score
minFeedbackScore.description: Exclude sellers below this public feedback score.

minMatchedListings.title: Minimum matching listings
minMatchedListings.description: Minimum sampled brand listings tied to one seller.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent Bright Data public-page requests.

maxProfileConcurrency.title: Profile concurrency
maxProfileConcurrency.description: Seller Profile/About/Feedback concurrency. Keep at 1 to avoid eBay/Bright Data rate limiting.

maxRequestRetries.title: Retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Maximum retries for one failed Web Unlocker request. Zero avoids multiplying latency and is the recommended default.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Page timeout
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: Seconds allowed for one public-page request.

dedupeMode.title: Deduplication
dedupeMode.description: Control whether all, only new, or new and updated seller leads are emitted.

dedupeStoreName.title: State store
dedupeStoreName.description: Named Key-Value Store used for cross-run seller state.
